name: dispatch-router
description: Asks a TypeSafe model which CLI and model should take each agent task and refuses unrouted launches. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it does nothing. Sends task text to api.typesafe.ai.

name: merge-gate
description: Refuses a merge Claude runs when the branch touches files outside its declared scope, carries a secret, or fails its tests; stops after three failed rounds. Needs gitleaks.

name: multi-agent-kit
description: A skill on splitting work between agents, plus hooks for tuios users (window list, window reaper that starts in dry-run). Each hook does nothing when its tool is missing.
